summary: Track 18 done. NEPCON is not a paper venue (trade-show series, no CFP/proceedings). Closest live option, ICACT 2026 Kathmandu (IEEE, Xplore #70625), is real and well-matched but deadline (15 Aug 2026) already closed before this task ran. Recommend targeting ICACT 2027 Kathmandu + IEEE Healthcom as backup, with a paper-vs-thesis scope split. No live 2026 CFP fits SPARK's timeline; flagging this honestly rather than forcing a fit.
result_text:
### Research question
Is NEPCON 2026 a real, live venue for an IEEE conference paper on SPARK, or is there a closer comparable IEEE Nepal-region / embedded-edge-AI conference with an open or upcoming CFP — and what's the recommended paper-vs-thesis scope split?

### Bottom line
NEPCON is not an academic paper venue at all — it's a trade-show/exhibition series (NEPCON Japan/China/Thailand, run by RX) with no CFP, no peer review, no proceedings. The closest real match, **ICACT 2026 (Kathmandu)** — an actual IEEE Xplore-indexed, IEEE Nepal Section–backed conference — fits well thematically but its submission deadline (15 Aug 2026, extended from 30 Jun/25 Jul) closed one week before this task ran. No live 2026 CFP realistically fits SPARK's own timeline (WP2 training results due 31 Oct 2026, thesis finalization ongoing). Practical target: **ICACT 2027 Kathmandu** (or **IEEE Healthcom 2027**, domain-closer but historically later/rolling deadline, ~June) as the actual submission cycle, prepared from finished WP2/thesis results.

### Key findings

- **Finding:** NEPCON is a manufacturing trade show, not a research venue.
  **Evidence:** NEPCON Japan/China/Thailand pages describe exhibitor booths, product/technology seminars, visitor registration — no submission portal, no proceedings, no peer review anywhere in any NEPCON-branded page found.
  **Source:** nepconjapan.jp, nepconchina.com, nepconthailand.com (official RX event sites).
  **Confidence:** Established.
  **Relevance to SPARK:** The task's premise ("NEPCON 2026 or comparable") needs redirecting entirely — there is no NEPCON paper track to target. Any thesis/tracker text referencing NEPCON as a paper venue should be corrected.

- **Finding:** ICACT 2026 Kathmandu is a real, currently-existing IEEE conference with a Nepal Section connection and Xplore indexing, but two same-named conferences exist and must not be conflated.
  **Evidence:** "2026 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Advanced Computing Technologies," 1–2 Sept 2026, Hilton Kathmandu, Honorary Chair Dr. Arun Timalsina (Chair, IEEE Nepal Section), submissions via ConfConnects (`app.confconnects.com/conference/wwrazM5QB8hSDwWL78wx`), IEEE Conference ID #70625, target IEEE Xplore + Scopus. Deadline extended to 15 Aug 2026 per an NSBM-linked Facebook post (a blog mirror showed an earlier "25 Jul" figure — the 15 Aug figure is the more recent/authoritative extension). Distinct from a same-acronym "ICACT 2026" run by NSBM Green University, Sri Lanka (Faculty of Computing, 3rd edition, prior edition held Nov 2025) — different organizer, different country, easily confused by name alone.
  **Source:** researchtek.com/2026/07/icact-2026-nepal.html (mirrors official CFP text); researchtek.com/2026/06/2026-3rd-international-conference-on... (ConfConnects link + IEEE conference ID); facebook.com/nsbm.lk deadline-extension post; icact.nsbm.ac.lk (the Sri Lankan namesake).
  **Confidence:** Established (existence, dates, organizer identity) / Supported inference (15 Aug being the final, not-further-extended deadline — blog/social sources, not the primary ConfConnects portal itself, which I could not fetch directly).
  **Relevance to SPARK: this cycle's deadline has already passed** (today: 22 Aug 2026). Not usable for 2026. Track topics (IoT/Smart Villages & Edge Computing; Intelligent Systems & Data Science) are a strong thematic fit for SPARK's next cycle.

- **Finding:** IEEE Healthcom is the best domain-fit IEEE conference found (wearables, fall/gait biometrics, edge/fog computing for wearable medical devices) but its 2026 cycle deadline has also passed.
  **Evidence:** Healthcom 2026 CFP topics explicitly list "biometric analysis (gait analysis, eye-tracking, falls, mHealth)" and "fog/edge/cloud computing for wearable medical devices." Healthcom 2026 paper deadline was 8 June 2026 (New York City edition); prior editions were global (2025: Abu Dhabi).
  **Source:** healthcom2026.ieee-healthcom.org/call-papers, /authors.
  **Confidence:** Established.
  **Relevance to SPARK:** Best topical match of anything found, but timing doesn't work for 2026. Worth tracking for Healthcom 2027 CFP (historically opens ~months ahead, deadline pattern suggests ~June).

- **Finding:** No other Nepal-region or Nepal-adjacent IEEE-sponsored venue has an open CFP window compatible with SPARK's Oct 2026 WP2 completion date.
  **Evidence:** Searched IEEE Nepal Section/Subsection pages, IEEE PES Nepal Chapter, general Nepal conference aggregators (conferencealert.com, allconferencealert.com) — no other IEEE-technically-co-sponsored, Nepal-hosted, open-CFP venue surfaced besides ICACT.
  **Source:** site.ieee.org/nepal, r10.ieee.org/nepal-pes, conferencealert.com/nepal, allconferencealert.com/nepal.
  **Confidence:** Supported inference (absence of evidence in a search-based sweep, not an exhaustive registry check).
  **Relevance to SPARK:** Confirms ICACT is genuinely the closest fit, not just the first result found.

### Evidence table

| Finding | Evidence | Source | Confidence | SPARK implication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NEPCON = trade show, not paper venue | No CFP/proceedings on any NEPCON site | nepconjapan.jp, nepconchina.com | Established | Drop NEPCON from any paper-venue plan |
| ICACT 2026 Kathmandu is real, IEEE-Xplore-track, Nepal Section–linked | CFP text, IEEE ID #70625, ConfConnects portal | researchtek.com (2 posts), NSBM Facebook post | Established / Supported inference (final deadline date) | Deadline (15 Aug 2026) already passed — target 2027 cycle instead |
| Same-name ICACT also exists at NSBM, Sri Lanka — do not conflate | Separate organizer, country, history | icact.nsbm.ac.lk | Established | Confirm correct ICACT before citing in thesis/paper plan |
| Healthcom = best topical fit, deadline passed | CFP topic list includes falls/gait/wearable edge computing | healthcom2026.ieee-healthcom.org | Established | Track Healthcom 2027 CFP opening as a second target |
| No other live Nepal-region IEEE CFP found | Sweep of Nepal Section/Chapter/aggregator pages | site.ieee.org/nepal, aggregators | Supported inference | ICACT remains best available option for next cycle |

### Contradictions and limitations
- Conflicting deadline figures for ICACT 2026 Kathmandu (25 Jul vs. 15 Aug) across two secondary sources — neither is the primary ConfConnects portal itself, which returned a permissions/fetch restriction in this session; the 15 Aug figure is more recent (later blog post + direct extension announcement) but not independently confirmed against the primary portal.
- This is a search-based sweep, not an exhaustive conference-registry audit; smaller or very recently announced CFPs may exist that didn't surface.
- Task's own premise (NEPCON as a candidate) doesn't hold up under research — flagging this rather than forcing a fit to a nonexistent CFP.
- No SPARK_TRACKER.md fetch was performed this session (no fresh repo clone permission this turn per operator policy), so the "SPARK contribution" framing below is built from sibling-track task specs (novelty claims 1–5, WP2 87.81% sensitivity, dual-layer gated architecture, SHAP local explainability, Ch.6 future-work items) rather than a direct tracker read — reasonably reliable given how consistently these facts recur across independent task specs, but not independently tracker-verified by this track.

### Recommendation
1. Remove NEPCON as a target venue anywhere it appears in tracker/thesis text — it has no paper track.
2. Treat **ICACT 2027 Kathmandu** as the primary target once it's announced (same organizing structure expected; historically ~1 year cadence) — prepare the paper against finished WP2 results (due 31 Oct 2026) plus the narrowed novelty claims from Track 1 (Action #26).
3. Track **IEEE Healthcom 2027** CFP opening as a stronger topical-fit backup/alternate — its scope (wearable fall/gait biometrics, edge computing for medical wearables) maps onto SPARK more precisely than ICACT's general-computing scope.
4. Proposed paper-vs-thesis split: paper = the narrowed novelty claim (dual-layer gated architecture + SHAP local explainability on MCU-class hardware) with WP2 benchmark results as the core contribution, kept to conference page limits (ICACT: 6-10pp; Healthcom: 6pp); thesis = full Ch.1-6 including dataset protocol (Action #23), full risk/BOM context, and all future-work roadmap items (camera fusion, cloud archival, duty-cycle, aquatic-detection) that don't belong in a focused conference paper.
5. Do not submit to either 2026 cycle — both are closed; don't let thesis timeline pressure produce a rushed non-IEEE/predatory-venue submission instead.
